name: Hello, Japan!
source:
Welcome to our visual novel titled “Hello, Japan!”

We created this visual novel as material for novice Japanese learners to read for fun. You can start reading this visual novel after just a few chapters into your 1st-year Japanese textbook.

This visual novel is designed as supplementary material for the textbook「TOBIRA 1: Beginning Japanese」but we believe that you can read this visual novel along with other major 1st-year Japanese textbooks as well.

[From the [url=http://hello-japan-vn.com/]official site[/url]]
